fields.title: Assemble context within budget
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Budget 6,000 tokens. Available: instruction 400, profile 300, dialogue history 2,400, found products 5,000, delivery rules 800.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Assemble the context and explain what you are cutting.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: instruction 400 and profile 300 are mandatory. Found products are the main value, but 5,000 won't fit: trim to 3,500 by picking the most relevant. History — compress into summary up to 600. Delivery rules — include only if the question is about delivery, determined before call. Reserve 200. Total ≈ 5,000–5,800. Key decision: trim by relevancy search, not by chopping off the end.
